name: Pico CSS
description: Pico CSS 2.1.1's look (soft, rounded, generous spacing, solid primary, shadowed cards) translated onto the t-* vocabulary. Pico's --pico-* variables are bridged to --t-* tokens so every palette flows through.
notes: Not vendored: pico.classless.min.css styles bare elements (dialog as a full-screen overlay, details/summary chevrons, nav li padding, button width 100 % in forms) and cannot be aliased onto read-only tailor markup (contract rule 5). skin.css re-declares Pico's metrics and visual rules against t-* selectors and keeps a --pico-* → --t-* bridge in :root so projects mixing Pico variables stay on-palette.
